about: Labelled pictures for the next screenshot reading measurement (plan 103, lane P1). Same shape as screenshot_eval_v0.json (v0 stays), plus the fields below. 'file' is a name inside the workshop's screenshots/plan103-set folder (give it to the script with --root); each file is the picture shrunk the way the plugin's Low attachment setting does it (longest side 800, JPEG quality 62). 'source' is where the full-size original sits, under the workshop's screenshots folder. New fields: 'game_named_on_screen' (false when the picture never writes the game's name, so a right answer has to come from what the game looks like); 'place' and 'place_aliases' (an area name, empty when none is legible or certain); 'expect_section' (the name of the library note whose subject is on screen, empty when there is none; 'expect_section_also' lists notes that also fit) - the test in tests/test_screenshot_eval_v1_labels.py checks every one names a real note; 'in_library' (false when the library holds no notes for the game, and its app_id is then only the Deck's own id); 'confidence' (how sure the labeller is of each label: high, medium, low, or none when the label is empty). 'boss' is the boss or named enemy on screen, empty when none; a boss with confidence 'low' is a guess. Pictures were chosen from what the Deck held on 2026-11-09: game screens only, near-duplicates dropped, the performance overlay and Steam's 'Screenshot Taken' pop-up left in where they were.
